title: Polishing with UI, Audio & VFX ✨
description: Add a heads‑up display, sound effects, particle systems, and win/loss screens.

slides.title: HUD – Heads‑Up Display 🖥️
slides.content:
# On‑Screen Feedback

Create a Widget Blueprint `WBP_HUD` that displays:

* **Interaction Prompt** – "Press E to pick up" (visible when looking at interactable).
* **Inventory Slot** – shows the currently held item (icon + name).
* **Objective Text** – "Find the key and escape!"

Bind the interaction prompt visibility to a variable in the Character (set to true when trace hits an interactable). Use **Property Binding** to automatically update.

Add the widget to viewport in the Character's BeginPlay (via Create Widget and Add to Viewport).

quizData.question: To automatically update a widget property (like visibility) without manual Set nodes, use _____ Binding.
quizData.explanation: Property Bindings are functions that return a value each frame, keeping widgets in sync automatically.

slides.title: Sound Design 🔊
slides.content:
## Audio Immersion

Import or use Starter Content sounds for:

* **Footsteps** – play randomly pitched footstep Sound Cue on movement (Animation Notify or character event).
* **Pickup** – a chime when grabbing an item.
* **Door Open** – creak Sound Cue played at door location.
* **Ambient** – subtle room tone (Air conditioning hum) from an Ambient Sound actor.

Create Sound Cues with randomisation and attenuation. Place Ambient Sound actors in the room. Use **Play Sound 2D** for UI (pickup) and **Play Sound at Location** for world effects.

quizData.question: Footstep sounds should use the same sample every time for consistency.
quizData.explanation: Randomising samples and pitch prevents repetition and sounds more realistic.

slides.title: Visual Effects (Niagara) 💥
slides.content:
## Sparkle and Glow

Add particle effects to make interactions satisfying:

* When picking up the key, spawn a burst of golden sparkles (**Niagara System** with simple sprite burst, additive material, upward velocity).
* The door, when opened, emits a glow or dust fall from the edges.
* Use **Spawn System at Location** attached to the key or door actor.

Create a Niagara System `NS_KeySparkle` with a short burst of 50 particles, scale down, and fade out. Use the **Particle Color** module to tint gold.

slides.title: Win Condition & Menu 🏆
slides.content:
# Escaping the Room

When the player interacts with the unlocked door, trigger:

1. A **Fade to Black** (use a UI overlay with animation).
2. Display a **Win Screen** widget ("You Escaped!") with a restart button.
3. Optionally, show a **Score** or **Time Taken** (using a Timer).

Use **Open Level** to restart the game, or just reload the same level.

The win screen is a separate Widget Blueprint added to viewport on door interaction.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use Event Dispatchers

On the door, create a dispatcher `OnDoorOpened`. The HUD listens to it and displays the win screen, plays victory music, etc. Keeps code clean.
